pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
$ORBIO | The price keeps falling. The network keeps working. 🪐

Since my last update:

• AI tokens served: 47.7B → 57.5B
• Cumulative API usage crossed $50K
• Protocol fees reached $426K
• Agent creator fees surpassed 7M ORBIO
• 2,052 agents launched

Meanwhile, market cap has fallen to ~$21M, nearly 81% below ATH.

I'm not ignoring the risks. Staking has declined, and 14-day API spending and inference purchases have weakened.

But this is exactly what I'm watching: can real AI demand eventually catch up with the infrastructure being built?

I'm still holding. I believe ORBIO has a chance to recover, but the next rally needs to be backed by sustainable demand, not just hype.

The story isn't over. 🪐
